description: ikFkBlend 0 returns the FK chain and ignores the IK controls. FK chain with the start control rotated 90 degrees about Z swings the whole chain about the origin: (1.8,2.4,0) goes to (-2.4,1.8,0) and (5,0,0) to (0,5,0), every joint rotated 90. The handle and pole are moved too and change nothing.
